Mia P: quick sync — we need final confirmation on distribution rights with SunflowerAI before Thursday so we can lock the marketplace SKU and SI bundle.
Leon K: timeline makes sense. what's the non-negotiable legal ask from our side?
Anya (Legal): export-control safe harbor language + attribution and a strict no-resale clause. also a short model-provenance blurb attached to listing.
Raj (Partnerships): FYI Sunflower verbally agreed to commercial redistribution with attribution, but I need the signed addendum. they pushed back on 'no-derivatives' — want clarity.
Nina (PM): for the marketplace SKU we need pricing splits, supported deployment SKUs (hosted/dedicated/private), and a clear support matrix. target public launch 2025-06-03 — still good?
Diego (Infra): private deploy package requires KMS integration + cert pinning + docs. they will ship quantized weights as an LZ4 tarball. I'll validate checksum procedures.
Mia P: also remember the HW partner bundle (Nuvia boards) — compatibility signoff required from HW PM.
Leon K: can Orbit Systems (SI) offer a managed-install variant? if yes, revenue share changes.
Raj (Partnerships): Orbit is OK with managed install. they proposed 60/40 rev split (Orbit 60) if they also provide training and first-line support.
Anya (Legal): 60/40 can work but add indemnity carveouts and no-sub-licensing without explicit approval.
Nina (PM): product question — marketplace listing needs a 'supported configs' table + footprint metrics. Diego, can you produce baseline perf numbers (p50 latency / QPS) on Nuvia + AWS g5 by Tue?
Diego (Infra): yes. I'll run the benchmark suite tomorrow: `tools/run_bench --model sunburst-v2 --hw nuvia --seq 512` and post results.
Mia P: comms: Sunflower requests 48h heads-up on any announcement; Orbit wants to co-author blog post. propose embargo lift: 2025-06-02 10:00 PT.
Leon K: PR wise that's ok. marketing will need final logos, boilerplate, and one-pager.
Raj (Partnerships): I'll chase Sunflower for the redistribution addendum. any objections to including a 'no black-box' provenance clause (we can audit weights provenance)?
Anya (Legal): +1 to audit rights for compliance customers and us, and include SLA response timelines for third-party bugs.
Nina (PM): ops question — support tiers: Orbit L1, Redwood L2, Sunflower L3 — can Sunflower commit to that?
Leon K: propose Orbit L1, Redwood L2, Sunflower L3. need written L3 SLA from Sunflower.
Raj (Partnerships): Sunflower agreed to best-effort L3 during sign-off call; will ask them to codify response targets.
Mia P: action items: Raj — secure signed addendum by Wed EOD; Diego — perf numbers Tue; Anya — draft distro/indemnity clause Wed; Nina — assemble marketplace bundle spec Thu.
deploy-bot: marketplace SKU creation task #4428 created by @Nina, ETA 2025-05-29
Mia P: thanks all — quick standup tomorrow 9:00am PT to close blockers. :thumbsup:
